title: Roast my trading lab. It grades your strategy honestly and my own bots are down $402k
author: QuanTradin
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/1wqs4s07rsmh1.png?width=1200&format=png&auto=webp&s=976144f58073fafb58113955953679f6cf568464

Built a backtesting engine that refuses to flatter you. Buys at the ask, sells at the bid, never the midpoint, never sees tomorrow, and scores everything on a slice of history the strategy was never tuned on.

You write the rule in plain English, it grades it, and then you can run it on a paper desk with $100k of pretend money. Free, no card. An AI agent can run the desk too if you want, over MCP.The reason I'm posting rather than quietly launching: I ran 249 of my own bots through it and they are down $401,996. Two of the seven strategies everyone teaches grade negative. I publish both of those numbers on the [site.So](http://site.So) the honest question is whether "we'll tell you your idea is bad" is a product anyone wants, or whether I've spent months building something that only I find interesting.

quantradin.com. Tear into it.
